title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle-vendor-rke2-flatcar-tuf-updates
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: customers running Redwood Private in air-gapped on-prem environments have asked for better compatibility with RKE2 + Flatcar combos and for signed offline bundles that can be verified at install time. This PR vendors rke2/flatcar artifacts into the offline bundle, integrates TUF metadata generation and client-side verification, and updates the installer/helm and terraform modules to support pinned digest installs and checksum verification.

Summary of changes: adds a new vendoring pipeline for rke2-flatcar artifacts, introduces TUF signing for bundle metadata, pins image/container digests in the helm charts used by the private installer, and extends terraform modules to expose offline bundle checksum validation so upgrades are safer. Includes a new e2e airgap test to validate install/upgrade in a simulated offline environment.

Checklist: 
- [x] Vendor rke2 and flatcar tarballs and metadata into offline bundle
- [x] Implement TUF metadata generation + client verification in installer
- [x] Pin helm chart images to digests and add checksum annotations
- [x] Extend terraform module with "offline_bundle_checksum" output and validation hook
- [x] Add e2e airgap integration test and CI job (flaky; rerun once)
- [x] Update docs and operator upgrade notes

Why TUF: In air-gapped environments operators need strong guarantees that the bundle they received is untampered. TUF provides an established, resilient method for signing and rotating metadata; this PR adds TUF metadata generation as part of the bundle build and adds a lightweight verification step to the installer that runs before unpacking.

Backward compatibility: The installer defaults to existing behavior for bundles without TUF metadata (legacy bundles will continue to install), but when metadata is present the installer will prefer verified install. We surface an operator warning when installing legacy bundles and recommend rotating to TUF-signed bundles on next maintenance window.

review_conversation:
Jonas Reed (reviewer): Security - please ensure TUF root keys are not checked into the repo. Suggest using KMS-backed key storage for production signing.
Author: moved signing keys out of repo and added instructions to docs/operators/airgap.md for KMS/HSM integration; if operator runs offline signing they can place keys on the signing host only.

Ava Gomez (reviewer): Installer - checksum verification looks racy when parallelizing unpack step, please serialize verification.
Author: made verifier run before parallel unpack; added unit test to simulate concurrent verification attempts.

Luca Moretti (reviewer): Terraform - need to expose the bundle checksum so automated pipelines can validate before triggering upgrade.
Author: added 'offline_bundle_checksum' output and an optional 'validate_before_apply' bool that runs a remote-exec to verify checksum; documented in terraform/modules/private_installer/README.md.

CI: e2e-airgap workflow failed on first run due to a network fetch timeout in the simulated offline test; reran job and it passed. Maintainers: marked workflow rerunnable to reduce CI friction.
Maintainer (Maya Patel): noted flaky test and added retry wrapper around the simulation harness to reduce false negatives.
Approvals: Jonas Reed approved, Ava Gomez approved after requested changes, Luca Moretti approved. Merge method: squash and merge.
release_notes: Added TUF-signed offline bundle support for rke2+Flatcar; vendored rke2 and Flatcar artifacts into the offline bundle; pinned helm chart images to digests; Terraform module exposes offline_bundle_checksum output for safer upgrades.
upgrade_notes: Operators upgrading to bundles produced after this PR should verify new bundle checksums using the Terraform 'offline_bundle_checksum' output or the installer verification step. Legacy bundles without TUF metadata remain supported; to migrate, re-publish your offline bundle using the 'scripts/vendor_offline_bundle.sh' pipeline and follow docs/operators/airgap.md for key management and verification steps.
testing: Unit tests added for tuf_client verification, helm templates validated with helm unittest, terraform modules tested with kitchen-terraform in a simulated environment, and an e2e airgap install/upgrade test added. CI runs an e2e-airgap workflow that is rerunnable to mitigate flakiness. Manual test: performed an on-prem install in VM cluster with isolation network and validated checksum enforcement and rollback on corrupted bundle.
